about: English source for the PickupRadar website preview. Translate "en" into the language; keep {placeholders} and blank lines. Do not translate PickupRadar, RadarPoints or city names.

getApp.title.note: Pop-up title on the website when an action needs the mobile app. Matches "Get the app".

getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.note: Pop-up when an action needs the mobile app. Keep the blank line. The app is not in the stores yet: do not say it can be downloaded.

getApp.cityAlert.en:
Get a launch alert when {city} goes live.

Launch alerts are set up in the mobile app.
getApp.cityAlert.note: Pop-up after tapping a city that is coming soon. {city} is the city name: keep {city} exactly as written. Keep the blank line.

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.note: Pop-up after tapping "Request your city". Keep the blank line.

store.iosSoon.note: Label shown instead of the App Store button until the iPhone app is released.

store.androidSoon.note: Label shown instead of the Google Play button until the Android app is released.

store.ios.note: App Store button (not shown yet). Use the wording Apple uses in this language if it exists.

store.android.note: Google Play button (not shown yet). Use the wording Google uses in this language if it exists.

saved.appOnly.en: Saving pickup points is available in the mobile app.
saved.appOnly.note: Saved tab on the website. Saving is only in the mobile app. Use the app's word for "pickup point".

home.noVenues.title.note: Shown only if a city has no pickup points. Use the app's word for "pickup point".

home.noVenues.body.en: No active pickup points found for this city.

location.useButton.en: Use my location to see nearby pickup points
location.useButton.note: Button on Home. The browser asks for location only after this tap.

location.deniedBrowser.en: Location is off. Allow it for this site in your browser settings for nearby distances, or choose a city to browse PickupRadar.
location.deniedBrowser.note: Shown when the browser blocked location. Say browser settings (not phone settings).

aria.filters.note: Screen-reader label for the row Nearby / Fast / Slow / Saved. Not shown on screen.

aria.tutorial.note: Screen-reader label for the tutorial screen. Not shown on screen.

aria.slide.note: Screen-reader label for each tutorial dot. Keep {number} and {total}, for example "Slide 1 of 3".

share.copied.note: Short confirmation after the share message and venue link were copied (when the phone cannot open its share sheet). Two or three words, like "Link copied".
